subject: LINAGE clause
notes: Zero margins are accepted (the permission — tested by the fixture compiling at all) and, per §13.18.34.4 GR1, must behave as an omitted phrase: LINAGE-COUNTER steps 1,2,3,4 identically on the explicit-zero file and the phrase-less control (GR7d, GR7c3). The columns pin GR7, NOT margin handling — a zero margin is the identity, so column equality is blind to how a margin is treated. Every WRITE is preceded by its own MOVE because §14.9.51.4 GR4 empties the record area on each successful WRITE.
